children: Kewaunee Scientific reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $66.32M and diluted EPS of $0.58, as demand in domestic lab construction softened versus the prior-year quarter.

¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net earnings attributable to Kewaunee Scientific Corporation”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share attributable to Kewaunee Scientific Corporation stockholders”.
Revenue decline driven by weaker domestic lab construction demand; overall sales fell to $66.32M from $71.10M a year earlier.
Channel mix: LPG segment down 6.4% and international sales down 7.8%, with softness in India partially offset by strength in APAC.
Gross margin improved to 29.6%, supported by stronger margins in the International segment and operational improvements.
Order backlog stood at $169M versus $205M in the prior-year period; company is focused on converting high quoting activity into awards through commercial and operational initiatives.
